authorization: User explicitly approved zero-sequence validation, pre-test commit/push, then exactly one formal test pass for five conditions and three seeds
primary_model_reason: Validation mean/attention differences are negligible; mean is simpler; attention retained as mechanism experiment regardless of test
epoch_selection: Validation LogLoss only; ties select earliest epoch
aggregation: Per-condition arithmetic mean and sample std (ddof=1) over the three fixed seeds; paired seed differences for the five comparisons
historical_reference: Original DeepFM seed 42 is reported separately, never inserted as a fourth seed or averaged into the control
zero_control_interpretation: Same frozen backbone, training loop, LR, batch, seed schedule and interface dimensions; hard-zero whole residual means predictions are mathematically seed-invariant. This is a pipeline null control, not three independent backbone fits or a control for effective trainable capacity.
context: All 15 conditions reuse the original immutable seed-42 DeepFM F123 checkpoint/scaler; backbone is never optimized
calibration: Primary and secondary comparisons use raw probabilities. No calibration refit or method search in this authorized test batch; historical calibration work remains separate.
time_semantics: Positive exposure timestamp proxies click-record time, feedback next Beijing day; source date strictly before target date. Test may include completed May 12 positives; no independent click timestamp.
test_policy: Only after zero validation, smoke/reload and pre-test freeze commit/push pass. One streaming inference pass per frozen checkpoint, no re-inference for reports. Persist an exclusive start marker; interruption requires investigation, never silent retry.
post_test_policy: No model, hyperparameter, epoch, length, priority or seed changes; no new configurations based on test. No significance claim from seed std alone.
